note: Overlay log (ADR-006), read by cecl.overlays and scripts/build_reserve.py. 'overlays': proposed overlays, each checked against the ADR-006 rules every run; only approved ones that pass every rule are booked. 'assessments': issues considered for an overlay and not proposed, with the decision. Aggregates only. Educational model; not an audited reserve.

assessments.decision: No overlay (Option B): the L-038 default shortfall is assessed at the expected-loss level; the LGD model's documented conservatism (L-033, 1.64x) more than offsets it.
